The cheap-audit ladder is the only workload that should run on idle #5+, and it must run through the project venv:

```bash
# idle-audit.sh — cheap-audit ladder (idle #5+, skip full 11-point)
set -euo pipefail
SDK="${1:-$PWD}"
cd "$SDK"

# Key lesson: system python lacks pytest-benchmark (confirmed below).

echo "== tests =="            && "$PY" -m pytest -q            # expect 106 passed
echo "== ruff =="             && ruff check src tests
echo "== hilo =="             && "$PY" -m h3_shim.cli hilo     # expect 94/21
echo "== guard =="            && "$PY" -m h3_shim.cli guard    # expect PASS
echo "== git =="              && git status --porcelain        # expect clean
echo "== cooldown (fleet.toml) =="
grep -E "cooldown|no_put|put" fleet.toml || true               # 7200, no PUT

# Cooldown gate: never PUT while cooldown is active / pinned in fleet.toml.
# (No git push, no version bump, no pip publish on idle ticks.)
```

If the audit is green, the correct "fix" is exactly nothing — push only when the cooldown expires and a real delta (dependency bump, bugfix, release) exists.
